fusions.name: Arm's-Length Swat
fusions.desc: Swats a target up to 3 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Rearing Startle
fusions.desc: Rears up and slams down, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and knocking them back 3.5 tiles. You move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bolting Bound
fusions.desc: Increases your movement speed by 35% for 6 seconds. You finish 2 tiles from where you stood, with 8% more dodge chance while it lasts.

fusions.name: Flinch and Flee
fusions.desc: Each time you are hurt by anything other than fire, 8 stamina comes back to you. Once every 5 seconds.
